about: The media this repository publishes, one record per file: what scripts/stamp_media_meta.py writes into it and the digest it leaves. The license and holders come from REUSE.toml.

profile/assets/banner-dark.svg.title: Kleidos organization banner, dark theme
profile/assets/banner-dark.svg.description: Kleidos, hardware password manager: your passwords, on a board you already own. Nine boards on one shelf show their real Kleidos screens: M5StickS3, M5StickC Plus2, M5StickC Plus 1.1, M5StickC Plus SE, M5Stack CoreInk, M5Stack CoreS3 SE, M5Stack Core2 v1.3, M5Cardputer ADV and LILYGO T-Deck Plus.
